# kubectl get deploy payment-api -o yaml (actual deployed state)
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: payment-api
  namespace: production
spec:
  replicas: 1
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - image: myapp/payment-api:v1.2.3
        resources:
          limits: {}
          requests:
            memory: "256Mi"
            cpu: "250m"
